provenance.paper_title: BundleSDF: Neural 6-DoF Tracking and 3D Reconstruction of Unknown Objects

latest_version.version_label: arXiv v1 / CVPR 2023 paper reviewed on 2026-08-31

representation_paths.memory_component: memory pool of retained posed RGB-D frames selected for multi-view diversity

evidence.section: Full paper: Sec. 3.2 Memory Pool and Sec. 3.3 Online Pose Graph Optimization
evidence.paraphrase: BundleSDF retains informative historical RGB-D observations with their poses in a memory pool. A subset selected for viewing overlap supports each online pose graph, while all stored frames are later consumed by the concurrently learned object field.

representation_paths.memory_component: coupled keyframe pose graph and per-video neural signed-distance field encoding object geometry and appearance

evidence.section: Full paper: Sec. 3.3 Online Pose Graph Optimization and Sec. 3.4 Neural Object Field
evidence.paraphrase: A pose graph jointly refines current and historical keyframe poses, while a per-video neural object field learns geometry and appearance from all memory frames. Optimized poses are written back to the pool, and the learned SDF supplies a unary loss to subsequent pose-graph updates; both states remain linked to the retained source frames.
The first observation initializes the memory pool, and later posed frames are admitted only when their viewpoint adds sufficient multi-view diversity under a fixed threshold rule.

evidence.section: Full paper: Sec. 3.3 Online Pose Graph Optimization and Sec. 3.4 Neural Object Field
evidence.paraphrase: During online tracking, Gauss-Newton pose-graph optimization corrects stored keyframe poses and concurrent gradient training updates the neural object field. The corrected poses and learned SDF are reused by later tracking steps, and training repeats as new memory frames arrive.

derived.hybrid_relation: Retained RGB-D frames, their pose-graph state, and the neural object field form a closed operative loop: frames train the field, the field refines stored poses, and both support subsequent tracking and reconstruction.

adjudication_notes: BundleSDF extends BundleTrack with a concurrently learned Neural Object Field; the paper explicitly describes repeated field training and bidirectional updates between the field and memory-frame poses.

These updates change operative memory content during tracking under fixed admission, selection, and optimization procedures. No deployed feedback changes those procedures, so the highest tier is T2, not T3.
